note: Virtuals Protocol launches. Times ISO-8601 UTC. USD values use VIRTUAL/USD from the Uniswap v3 VIRTUAL/USDC pool on Base at the trade hour. mcap = spot price x total supply (FDV-style; Virtuals agent supply is fixed at 1B).

fields.token/pre_token/curve_pair/lp: addresses (lowercase); pre_token trades on curve_pair (bonding curve) before graduation; lp = Uniswap V2 pool after graduation
fields.cohort: case_study | top_mcap (outcome-selected, never used for base rates) | graduated_recent | random (seeded random sample of launches with >=20 holders, outcome-blind; base rates use this)
fields.first_buyers[]: first 25 distinct buyers: short id, t_s since first buy, VIRTUAL and USD size, nonce_before (Base), contract_wallet, fresh (EOA with <=2 prior txs), wallet_age_days (case studies), prior_early_launches (times this wallet was a first-25 buyer in an earlier library launch)
fields.fresh_first_buyers / fresh_cluster_size: detector-2 rule adapted to EVM: >=3 fresh first buyers whose first buys fall within 6 h
fields.curve: bonding-curve phase: trades, buyers, VIRTUAL in/out, first_buy_to_graduation_h, fill_pct_per_h (net VIRTUAL vs the 42,000 VIRTUAL graduation threshold per hour), launch/peak/end mcap, buy_size (median/p75/p90, %>$1k, top buyer share), buy_size_by_hour
fields.curve_mcap_grid: mcap (USD) at fixed hours after the first buy: 0.083, 0.25, 0.5, 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 24, 48
fields.stages[]: first time mcap reached $10K/$30K/$40K/$100K/$1M/$10M: elapsed_h since first buy and (curve phase) holders, top10_pct (of total supply, curve inventory excluded), gini, unique buyers, buy sizes, sell/buy ratio
fields.post: after graduation: first-24h buy sizes and peak, long-horizon path (GeckoTerminal hourly/daily or archive reserve samples), peak_mcap_usd + peak_at, CoinGecko ATH for tokens older than 180 days
fields.outcome: peak_mcap_usd, peak_at, reached_1m, reached_10m, graduated, hours_to_<stage>k
fields.coverage: what was and was not available for this launch
